_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: products
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, organization_id) REFERENCES categories (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (unit_id, organization_id) REFERENCES units (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tax_category_id, organization_id) REFERENCES tax_categories (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: product_barcodes
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: product_prices
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id))

data.name: product_images
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: stock_locations
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (location_type IN ('sales_floor', 'warehouse', 'returns', 'damaged'))

data.name: inventory_transactions
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (status IN ('posted', 'reversed'))

CHECK (transaction_type IN ('opening_balance', 'purchase_receipt', 'sale', 'sale_return', 'adjustment_increase', 'adjustment_decrease', 'transfer_shipment', 'transfer_receipt', 'stock_count_correction', 'reversal'))

data.name: inventory_ledger_entries
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: inventory_balances
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: stock_counts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (count_type IN ('full', 'cycle'))
CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled'))

data.name: stock_count_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (stock_count_id, organization_id) REFERENCES stock_counts (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
